a database query cursor management means 10D for specifying a record to obtain data from the database 2 based on the variable job file; a variable data generation means 10C for successively generating variable data by using the obtained data; and a variable data transmission means 10F for successively transmitting the variable data to a printer 3.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT", "language": "en", "title_language": "en", "text_quality": "title_abstract", "text_hash": "a3b9ea77f9b495181a20909b150bea9a3020c2ff7e1500c9c682988ccd3c7909", "title_text_id": "ac86a58b7bb3e7fcf561408e23811846fea2c82aa4c14fa68fa2b21c8df85fd7", "abstract_text_id": "69a20b73f394145afb41b34a9856ab9d803d1341c5a872a5d05e1ac1905c0c7b", "source": "patents-public-data.patents.publications", "translated": null, "priority_date": "2009-04-24", "selection_role": "near_center", "center_cosine": 0.9043292999267578, "abstract_truncated": false}, {"row_idx": 85029, "family_id": "google:18079943", "pub_id": "unresolved:1381741a3ffd3d299f773fc1", "publication_id": "JP-H10161248-A", "title": "Photofinishing system", "abstract": "PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enable a customer to easily and surely obtain convenience being equal to network photo service by printing the retrieval ID information of a prescribed recording medium for image data on the prescribed recording medium according to a prescribed forth and outputting it. SOLUTION: A print 6 is produced at a simultaneous printing time and an order print 9 is produced by printing the retrieval ID information used when the print is ordered on a prescribed paper and outputting it. The customer orders the print by writing necessary matters such as the number of printing sheets on the sheet 9 and giving it to an operator or sending it to a photo studio from his/her home by a facsimile equipment. By the photo studio receiving the order, the information of the order is inputted to an image server 3 by using an order information input means 5. By the server 3, photographic image data specified based on the retrieval ID information inputted from the input means 5 is retrieved from the stored photographic image data and outputted as the print by a printer 4.", "language": "en", "title_language": "en", "text_quality": "title_abstract", "text_hash": "b9cf78454b20344cdcc0720b00ede10976686d5ce0d947692a59656915ed706d", "title_text_id": "d07bda2e3440a9f5fd7fa9e61a9a5593a79b809b3e20e9259c400043206db25f", "abstract_text_id": "8fe0b97e13243744364af8f39234912a9ec30f48e61bcbb40d44b4da676e08c5", "source": "patents-public-data.patents.publications", "translated": null, "priority_date": "1996-11-27", "selection_role": "edge", "center_cosine": 0.7920154333114624, "abstract_truncated": false}, {"row_idx": 33605, "family_id": "google:14391551", "pub_id": "unresolved:cdd93fffd54cac08710f3272", "publication_id": "JP-H09274642-A", "title": "Image processor", "abstract": "PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an image processor with which the kind of printing or the position of printing is not limited in the case of printing the completion of processing or serial numbers onto originals. SOLUTION: Original information read by an original input part 1 is temporarily stored in an image; memory part 20. A processor part 22 sends one part of data stored in the image memory part 20 to an image output part 2, prints them on this original information and executes instructed processing. Since this printing is performed by processing at the processor part 22, the kind or position of printing is not limited. Besides, it can be discriminated from the result of printing onto the original information whether the original information is properly read and recognized or not. In this vase, a predetermined image is printed on this original so as to easily recognize the correspondence between the original information and the output of the processing result or the result calculated based on the recognized result of original information is printed on this original.", "language": "en", "title_language": "en", "text_quality": "title_abstract", "text_hash": "2b4d20a03fa0116fe218d42c2b5b15f54e34bc26fe2074aeef1eb2f86596b742", "title_text_id": "92625f87947270437dece7365569d6f1fd9264d83708ecac1d1abaa641a20d1b", "abstract_text_id": "676d48bd212abcadd7a102afea19bd504a66a8aad173d018a43c78d5e101738f", "source": "patents-public-data.patents.publications", "translated": null, "priority_date": "1996-04-03", "selection_role": "edge", "center_cosine": 0.7876609563827515, "abstract_truncated": false}, {"row_idx": 173939, "family_id": "google:40660531", "pub_id": "JP2009087217A", "publication_id": "JP-2009087217-A", "title": "Device, system and program for document management", "abstract": "<P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a document management device, a document management system and a document management program for which printing is performed with the same print parameter as that applied when a form is printed, even when a print source document is acquired from the page ID of a scanned form and printed.  <P>SOLUTION: An electronic document to be printed is stored in an electronic document storage section 22, and metadata such as a paper document or the like output from an image processor 10 is stored in a metadata storage section 21. When a reproduction instruction of the paper document is carried out by the image processor 10, a print parameter used for printing the paper document is acquired from the metadata storage section 21, and printing is carried out on the basis of the print parameter.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT", "language": "en", "title_language": "en", "text_quality": "title_abstract", "text_hash": "b3e3f890878f493b284bb9f9b514c37667a89b55db4f4192798b0c4c5538eb94", "title_text_id": "57532acba12f5a42c43c5bfd0065f2f73fce223ab3fdfa57d6f9f9180e1cfc53", "abstract_text_id": "eff8bf7b05efcdc181958783a9e4314a1df91063ee53f5a1725d4c0e0e40a1ee", "source": "patents-public-data.patents.publications", "translated": null, "priority_date": "2007-10-02", "selection_role": "random", "center_cosine": 0.8502824306488037, "abstract_truncated": false}, {"row_idx": 100132, "family_id": "google:19020216", "pub_id": "JP2002373066A", "publication_id": "JP-2002373066-A", "title": "Printing system, printer, print data generating device and program for generating print data", "abstract": "PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To make the degree of security high in a printing system in which a print data generating device and a printer are connected through a network. SOLUTION: A client PC 10 for generating print data generates a control program for controlling a printing operation in the printer 40, associates the generated control program with pregenerated print contents and outputs the control program associated with the pregenerated print contents as print data. The printer 40 separates the print data acquired from a print data generating device between the control program and the print contents and prints the separated print contents while controlling a printing operation according to the separated and extracted control program. Since the client PC 10 side can freely set a security mechanism by thinking out a control program, the degree of security can be made higher than that of a simple authentication number.", "language": "en", "title_language": "en", "text_quality": "title_abstract", "text_hash": "4470e4d676ceeb7bdb9bf98cab31bca079266683e5954c526ba53c701e127b1f", "title_text_id": "c2de56c59800a47f269a72fceda135af4719d37e52d3d0e45fa18b7dac54a2b0", "abstract_text_id": "0771f32612c9791042c75934e52102da789282ec8b3e056ef3422f54996c2b79", "source": "patents-public-data.patents.publications", "translated": null, "priority_date": "2001-06-14", "selection_role": "random", "center_cosine": 0.8648213148117065, "abstract_truncated": false}, {"row_idx": 164912, "family_id": "google:39241760", "pub_id": "JP2008059062A", "publication_id": "JP-2008059062-A", "title": "Printing system, print control unit, and print control program", "abstract": "<P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To select a printer intended by a user.  <P>SOLUTION: When receiving a print job from a client terminal 30, a printer decision part 253 in a print server 20 selects a printer 30 based on the print job and print refusal information stored in a print refusal information management table 232. A printer confirmation control part 254 performs processing to make the user of the client terminal 10 of the transmission source of the print job confirm whether to permit printing by the selected printer 30, and when it is decided that it is confirmed that printing is refused based on the confirmation result to be responded and transmitted from the client terminal 10, a print refusal information management part 256 updates the print refusal information of the pertinent printer 30 in a print denial information management table 232.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT", "language": "en", "title_language": "en", "text_quality": "title_abstract", "text_hash": "2deb7ec06ded37e1d96845d7dfb36202093fe3d309569425d64aeea4e873e93e", "title_text_id": "41df9f13f1b4ccec809d9aa0ee38aa50f36abdd7439f27ccc68ca6b1242eb09b", "abstract_text_id": "1f0000f70cff4129a4ad9e3df5a169f4dda5b4fbea78a9ec497409bf0b58ad5b", "source": "patents-public-data.patents.publications", "translated": null, "priority_date": "2006-08-29", "selection_role": "random", "center_cosine": 0.8746144771575928, "abstract_truncated": false}, {"row_idx": 140121, "family_id": "google:35498263", "pub_id": "JP2005345825A", "publication_id": "JP-2005345825-A", "title": "Photographic print assortment apparatus, method and system, and digital still camera", "abstract": "<P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enable a photographic print to be simply send to a designated destination.  <P>SOLUTION: The delivery address data of the photographic print 13 is registered together with image data as ancillary information on a memory card 23. A photographic printer 16 reads the delivery destination data from the memory card 23 and writes the data to a radio tag 46 embedded into the photographic print 13 printed with the image. A sorter 17 reads the delivery address data from the radio tag 46 and assorts the photographic prints 13 by each of the delivery destinations. The photographic prints 13 rearranged by each delivery destination are packed and delivered. Therefore a user placing an order on the print is able to send the photographic print 13 without carrying out delivery work by himself or herself.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2006,JPO&NCIPI", "language": "en", "title_language": "en", "text_quality": "title_abstract", "text_hash": "601e5c8cc38607b4fa634489d760338f72a5816eb36d246074440b07d7c7163b", "title_text_id": "83d69657c49f7aca16307078e0e5c2506bdbc7b4eafa3234e26c9e2c59d09447", "abstract_text_id": "46149035060d1da7bca668ef29b7db11000ce484e590a45f599ec617b93cd6a2", "source": "patents-public-data.patents.publications", "translated": null, "priority_date": "2004-06-03", "selection_role": "diverse", "center_cosine": 0.795436680316925, "abstract_truncated": false}]}
